caption: Spectral unmixing requires images with an explicit channel axis and at least three dimensions.
proof: Removing exactly the two reviewed guards recovers every original source byte. Apply guard precedes float32 allocation and indexing; control guard precedes channel-axis lookup. No upper bound, single explicit channel and arbitrary leading axes retained. No matrix math/API prose/settings/source rewrite. Runtime/locale checks separately required.
